names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 11 марта ст. ст., «Патрикий (Петров), иеромонах, исп.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line declines the forename and gives the name without the surname. The calendar sets the surname in brackets and it is kept so.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 11 марта ст. ст. closes with: «Прп. Патрикия исп (1933).»

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Патрикия исп (1933).»

attestations.note: The line is four words and a year. Neither the day page nor name page 9238 carries a life, and the day page prints no hymn under his name. The name page lists a second day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia; it is recorded here and the folder does not render on it. The calendar calls him a confessor and not a martyr, which is why `new-martyr` is not among this folder's types. azbyka.ru, which has lives for some of the martyrs and confessors of these years, was not read for him.
